page: Microsoft Azure D372ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 server family. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features an x86_64 architecture with 372 dedicated vCPUs and 1488.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The server is equipped with 22,677 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The massive local NVMe SSD storage capacity makes it suitable for workloads requiring high-capacity, low-latency local disk access.

In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the D372ds_v7 provides high resource density with a massive allocation of dedicated vCPUs and local storage on a single instance, reducing the need for multi-node cluster overhead for large-scale workloads. This server is designed for large databases, enterprise applications, data warehousing, and general-purpose workloads that require substantial compute power coupled with extensive local storage capacity.
